name: BOSKO & FRIENDS
description: Where Looney Tunes began: the 1929–1931 Bosko shorts and the first Merrie Melodies, public domain by age.
contentNote: Bosko (1929) is a minstrel-derived caricature — the very first Looney Tune, presented here as animation history. Pre-Code humor throughout. The one Censored Eleven title from this era is excluded.
rightsNote: AGE basis: US publications this old are public domain deterministically — the only risk is a wrong release date. CAVEAT ON THE 1931 TITLES: they clear by AGE on 2027-01-01; until then their PD status rests on documented non-renewal (NR) — searched 2026-07-29 against CCE 3rd Series Parts 12-13, renewal sections 1958 and 1959 both halves, no renewal found. Original B&W prints only — the 1970s redrawn/colorized versions in the same IA item were renewed in 1994 and are separately copyrighted; the file selection explicitly excludes anything marked Redrawn or Colorized.
